title: image_to_3d arguments
description: Reconstruct a textured 3D model with Pixal3D from an original front image, optionally with left, back and right views of the same subject. Returns a downloadable binary GLB model, not an image or video. Takes no prompt. Use original stills with consistent framing and height; never substitute screenshots or invented views.

sourceImageIndex.description: Front image: negative indices select uploads (-1 is the first), non-negative indices select generated images. Omit to use the latest image.

source_image_url.description: REST alternative to sourceImageIndex: retrievable front image URL.

leftViewImageIndex.description: Subject own LEFT side facing the camera (subject faces screen-left). Any subset of orbit views enables multi-view reconstruction.

rightViewImageIndex.description: Subject own RIGHT side facing the camera (subject faces screen-right). Do not swap left and right.

left_view_image_url.description: REST alternative for the left view.

back_view_image_url.description: REST alternative for the back view.

right_view_image_url.description: REST alternative for the right view.

meshTargetFaces.description: Triangle budget. Default 700000; choose a lower budget for real-time use.

textureSize.description: Base-colour texture and UV atlas size. Default 4096.
